tool: headless Chromium driven by puppeteer-core (scripted, not manual browser use)
build: dashboard served by tools/serve_dashboard.py on 0.0.0.0:8000 from this working tree
corrections: Four checks in earlier drafts were wrong in the script, not in the application, and were corrected before this log was merged: the custom-workload mean was expected to be 10.4 u (the typed four-process FCFS workload is 4.25 u, and the rows were verified by hand); the footer selector was `.status-bar` instead of `.app-foot`; the restore notice was looked for inside `#view` although it is the `#banner` element; and a check for an aged-out run was applied after the run had already been replaced by a fresh one, so it was replaced by a dedicated restart flow (part 3b).
The Gantt inspector check first failed because the click landed on a legend swatch; the block-level click and the keyboard path both pass in the merged run.
